inspection.question: Does authorized real SMTP validation expose a proven security gap requiring code changes before the external test?
evidence: docs/CERTIFICACION_N7_7_EMAIL_EMPRESARIAL.md certifies tenant isolation, durable idempotency, atomic outbox claims, rate limits, SMTP timeouts, sender allowlist, feature gating, sanitized audit and provider-event integrity/deduplication.

The remaining risk is operational access to authorized non-production SMTP credentials/configuration and verified sender/provider infrastructure, which must not be read, exposed or modified by this automation.
A missing or invalid external SMTP configuration must remain fail-closed; no fallback credential or secret may be synthesized.
inspection.scopeDecision: No runtime security delta is justified. Preserve N7.7 controls and require N8.5.G to demonstrate a real external send using authorized Desarrollo configuration without exposing secrets.
inspection.rollback: Evidence-only; no security/runtime delta was made.
